explication: Signal iOS is a private messaging application. The principal workflow is: a user launches or provisions the app, opens a conversation, composes content, and sends or receives messages through local persistence and Signal’s service. Calls, media capture, sharing, polls, attachments, backups, device transfer, and notifications form distinct supporting stages. Several core messaging modules were not sampled, so those nodes use exact enclosing directories and only high-level documented relationships are shown.
